capabilities: Record vault file events (create, modify, delete, rename) with line counts across devices
Maintain per-agent cursors so each AI reads only unread changes
Deduplicate the same edit recorded by multiple devices using content hashes
Install the agent reading protocol into AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md automatically
Browse recent changes, run a health check, and pause or resume recording from the status bar
extras: Fully local with no network calls; v2 data layout migrates old logs with a backup; author warns Windows is not smoke-tested yet and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; donations accepted via Buy Me a Coffee and Afdian.
problem: Obsidian gives AI agents no way to see what changed since their last visit, so they must rescan the whole vault and spend context on unchanged files.

relations.evidence: The plugin installs a short reading protocol into your vault's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md on first enable.

summary: Change-feed recorder that logs every vault edit (create/modify/delete/rename) and gives each AI agent a cursor to incrementally read what changed.
